description: Every Unicode scalar Go's unicode.IsSpace reports, as its hexadecimal code point, measured over 0 to 0x10FFFF. Go's strings.TrimSpace removes exactly these, so they are the characters the Dispatch server reads a create's content as blank by (the `blank :=` line of jsonArtifactUpload, packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/api/artifacts.go), and goBlankPattern in packages/envoy-client/src/dispatch-execute.ts writes the same set out so that `dispatch artifact` reads the same text as blank before it sends anything. One test on each side measures its own language over every scalar and holds the answer to this list: TestUnicodeIsSpaceReportsTheCommittedScalars in packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/text/whitespace_fixture_test.go, and `goBlankPattern` > `calls blank exactly the scalars the committed list holds` in packages/envoy-client/src/__tests__/dispatch-execute.test.ts. A Go release or a Unicode version that moves the set reddens the Go test; an edit to either side alone reddens the other; the list and the pattern are corrected together.
